# Content Strategy Skill for Muse

This skill acts as your content strategist: it plans content through the "searchable vs shareable" lens, helps you define 3–5 content pillars with hub-and-spoke topic clusters, maps keywords to buyer stages (awareness, consideration, decision, implementation) with proven modifier lists, and mines ideas from your keyword exports, sales call transcripts, surveys, and competitor research. Ideas are scored on customer impact, content-market fit, search potential, and resource cost, producing a prioritized editorial roadmap. Caveat: the scoring is only as good as the research inputs you provide — no data, no prioritization. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
